thread:
maria-support: Heads up — AcmeHealth reporting a flood of 429s on their dedicated pool after the plan-migration completed at ~16:04 UTC. They say it started immediately after the migration and stayed for ~15m. They attached a short log sample.

acmeops: Yep, every /v1/generate is returning 429s. Response headers show `X-RateLimit-Reason: tenant_quota_exceeded`. We didn't increase traffic.

maria-support: Can you paste minimal repro steps or curl so we can reproduce?

acmeops: curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}'
We only get 429s. Also sending syslog excerpt:```
[2026-03-16T16:05:12Z] tenant=acme status=429 reason=quota_key_not_found mapped_key=tenant:acme:legacy_rate:12345
[2026-03-16T16:05:12Z] routing=quiet-pool pool_id=dedicated-us-west-2-acme
```

henry-runtime: That stacktrace/line looks like the classic orphaned-rate-key after plan-sync. When the plan migration script renames the tenant rate key it sometimes leaves a legacy mapping in the routing table. If the runtime can't resolve the new key it emits quota_key_not_found and returns 429 instead of falling back.

aj-infra: Confirming — I queried Redis and found a stale mapping entry: key `tenant:acme:legacy_rate:12345` exists but points to `weight=0` and an expired TTL. The autoscaler was seeing the pool as underutilized and suppressed warmup.

aj-infra: Repro steps I ran locally: 
1) apply legacy mapping: `HSET tenant_rates acme:legacy_rate 12345`
2) hit /v1/generate with acme key -> 429 with reason quota_key_not_found
3) delete mapping -> requests route to fallback but often to quiet-pool until warmup completes.

henry-runtime: Two options: quick repair of the tenant-rate mapping, or a runtime guard so missing mapping falls back to a permissive temporary rate while we fix mapping. I'll prepare a small hotfix for the guard.

aj-infra: I can run a repair operation now. Admin endpoint: 
```
POST https://internal.redwood/api/admin/tenants/acme/repair_rate
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Body: {"from_key":"tenant:acme:legacy_rate:12345","to_key":"tenant:acme:rate:67890"}
```

sara-cs: @acmeops — we'll run the repair at 16:30 UTC and monitor. Sorry about the interruption.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Plan-sync rollout #8273 automatically paused due to tenant-rate-check failure.

henry-runtime: Quick mitigation we can deploy (hotfix scheduled 17:00 UTC): when mapped_key missing -> log metric `orphaned_rate_key` and apply temporary fallback bucket with short TTL (60s) so downstream doesn't instantly 429. Long-term we still need mapping repair. PR #5420 open.

acmeops: Please confirm this won't cause temporary overage billing. We need to avoid surprising charges.

maria-support: Billing safe — fallback buckets are meter-neutral and marked as recovery windows; finance confirmed no retro billing for temporary fallback. I'll follow up in the ticket.

aj-infra: Repair executed at 16:33 UTC. Post-repair logs: ```
[2026-03-16T16:33:21Z] admin=aj-infra action=repair_rate tenant=acme from=tenant:acme:legacy_rate:12345 to=tenant:acme:rate:67890 status=ok
[2026-03-16T16:33:28Z] tenant=acme status=200 routed_pool=dedicated-us-west-2-acme
```

aj-infra: Observed 429 rate drop from ~35% -> ~1% within 2 minutes. Warmup completed in ~5 minutes and autoscaler increased replicas as expected.

henry-runtime: I'll merge the fallback guard tonight so future migrations won't hit hard 429s. Also adding an alert on `orphaned_rate_key > 0` to catch early.

sara-cs: Thanks team. @acmeops — can you confirm traffic looks normal on your side now?

acmeops: Confirmed — error rate back to baseline. No more 429s after 16:38. We'll keep monitoring for 24h. Thanks for the fast repair.

maria-support: Filing followup ticket: support-12488. Postmortem will include root cause (legacy mapping leftover from plan-sync), steps we ran (repair and warmup), and action items: 1) runtime fallback guard (henry) 2) admin pre-check in plan-sync to remove orphaned keys (aj) 3) alerting on orphaned_rate_key (infra).

henry-runtime: ETA for guard: tomorrow AM. PR reference: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/5420.

aj-infra: I'll add a preflight check to the plan-sync job to validate mappings and fail the job if any legacy keys exist.

sara-cs: I'll update the customer with the timeline and postmortem once done. :white_check_mark:

maria-support: Great job team, closing this thread when postmortem is posted.

(reacts: :eyes: from henry-runtime, :thumbsup: from aj-infra)
